answer: Every claim climbs the relic of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the grove re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. The onyx of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work.
